name: Word Count & Text Stats
tagline: Count words, characters, sentences and reading time
description: Analyze any text: word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, unique words, estimated reading time, and top 10 most frequent words. Useful for writers, editors, and content creators.

expert_defs.name: word_count_analyze
expert_defs.description: Analyzes text and returns word count, character counts, sentence count, paragraph count, unique words, reading time and top frequent words. Param: text (string). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: sentences = [s for s in re.split(r'[.!?]+', text) if s.strip()]
paragraphs = [p for p in text.split('\n\n') if p.strip()]

result = {'words': len(words), 'characters': len(text), 'characters_no_spaces': chars_no_space, 'sentences': len(sentences), 'paragraphs': len(paragraphs), 'unique_words': len(freq), 'reading_time': str(reading_min) + ' min', 'top_words': [{'word': w, 'count': c} for w, c in top]}
